name: Nuuk Art Museum (Nuuk Kunstmuseum)
watch: An excluded funder is current. The museum says a 'generous donation from the Augustinusfonden' let it buy the entire Melting Barricades collection in 2024. Augustinus Fonden is a Scandinavian Tobacco Group holder. The exhibition ran 10 Oct to 30 Dec 2024.
why_flagged: An excluded funder is current. The museum says a 'generous donation from the Augustinusfonden' let it buy the entire Melting Barricades collection in 2024. Augustinus Fonden is a Scandinavian Tobacco Group holder. The exhibition ran 10 Oct to 30 Dec 2024.
records_note: A municipal museum; its site links one annual report, for 2015, and names only staff, with no accounts or donors.

name: Ny Carlsberg Glyptotek
funding: Carlsberg Foundation and Ny Carlsberg Foundation (DKK 750M each in March 2026 for restoration) plus a state operating grant. Augustinus Fonden gave DKK 1.53M in 2025 for a Gauguin purchase.
watch: Augustinus Fonden's investment arm holds over 25% of Scandinavian Tobacco Group (cigars, pipe tobacco).
why_flagged: Carlsberg Foundation and Ny Carlsberg Foundation (DKK 750M each in March 2026 for restoration) plus a state operating grant. Augustinus Fonden gave DKK 1.53M in 2025 for a Gauguin purchase.
records_note: It posts yearly reports and signed accounts for 2018 to 2025, names its board, and thanks eleven funders by name in the 2021 report.

name: NYU Tisch School of the Arts
watch: Steve Tisch sits on the Dean's Council of NYU Tisch School of the Arts, named after a 1982 donation from his father and uncle. DOJ files show emails from 2013 to 2017 in which Epstein described women to him, including an April 2013 thread titled "Ukrainian Girl".
why_flagged: Part of NYU, named for a 1982 gift from Laurence and Preston Robert Tisch. Its giving page names Google, the Steven & Alexandra Cohen Foundation and the HFPA Charitable Trust.
records_note: No records of its own: parent NYU posts financial reports and audited statements for 2007 to 2025; Tisch names three donors and 38 council members.

name: Oakland Museum of California
funding: Expenses $20.4M (FY2025); City of Oakland subsidy, foundation trustees, members.
watch: Chevron and Bloomberg Philanthropies are current Benefactor-level corporate supporters, and the museum also uses Bloomberg Connects.
why_flagged: Chevron and Bloomberg Philanthropies are current Benefactor-level corporate supporters, and the museum also uses Bloomberg Connects.
records_note: It posts yearly Impact Reports, audited statements and Form 990s for 2021 to 2025, names corporate partners by tier and lists 2025/2026 trustees.

name: Ohara Museum of Art
funding: Ohara Art Foundation. Official partners (1 April 2026) include Kurabo, Kuraray, Chugoku Bank, Sanyo Shimbun, ENEOS Mizushima refinery, Okayama Gas, Yokoyama Sekiyu and Japan Tobacco, plus over 200 other firms.
watch: ENEOS Mizushima refinery, Okayama Gas and Yokoyama Sekiyu are fossil fuel partners; Japan Tobacco is a tobacco partner. All are on the 2026 list.
why_flagged: Ohara Art Foundation. Official partners (1 April 2026) include Kurabo, Kuraray, Chugoku Bank, Sanyo Shimbun, ENEOS Mizushima refinery, Okayama Gas, Yokoyama Sekiyu and Japan Tobacco, plus over 200 other firms.
records_note: Its foundation posts yearly business reports for 2024 and 2025, financial statements and a director list; partners are logos dated April 2026.

name: OK16 cultural hub
watch: Creative cluster in former factory halls at Kastryčnickaja 16 (bank bought them for US$3M); art director Maria Kalesnikava; venue operated by ArtCorporation. Belgazprombank has since tried to sell the buildings.
why_flagged: Creative cluster in former factory halls at Kastryčnickaja 16 (bank bought them for US$3M); art director Maria Kalesnikava; venue operated by ArtCorporation. Belgazprombank has since tried to sell the buildings.
records_note: The Warsaw relaunch has no website and no named funders; Zerkalo (Aug 2026) says the team is formed and funding is being sought.

name: Onassis Stegi
funding: Run by the Alexander S. Onassis Foundation, funded entirely by profits of its Business Foundation, which invests in shipping and real estate. Corporate sponsors exist; no budget is published.
watch: Onassis built his fortune on tankers chartered to oil majors: no flag. Teachers stopped work in February 2025 against the Foundation's Onassis Public Schools.
why_flagged: Onassis built his fortune on tankers chartered to oil majors: no flag. Teachers stopped work in February 2025 against the Foundation's Onassis Public Schools.
records_note: The Onassis Foundation site is behind a bot check, so its reports, accounts, sponsor page and board could not be checked.

name: Ordrupgaard
funding: State museum since 1953 on insurer Wilhelm Hansen's bequest; Finn Juhl House funded by a private donor.
watch: Augustinus Fonden and Det Obelske Familiefond both hold Scandinavian Tobacco Group stakes.
why_flagged: Augustinus Fonden and Det Obelske Familiefond both hold Scandinavian Tobacco Group stakes.
records_note: Ordrupgaard, a state museum, posts its 2024 and 2025 annual reports with full accounts, but names no funders and lists no board.

name: Palacio Libertad
watch: Officials asked for four works to come down; the fileteadores show did not open (2025). The Indigenous Art Biennial show was pulled in 2026.
why_flagged: Federal state centre run by the Culture Secretariat. Formerly Centro Cultural Kirchner; renamed by decree 897/2024 on 10 October 2024. No sponsors are listed.
records_note: The centre's own site sits behind a bot check, so its reports, accounts, funders and board could not be checked.

name: Palais de Tokyo
funding: French state, plus patrons: Fondation Engie, Richard Mille, Ruinart, Swiss Life, Matmut, Revolut, Hugo Boss, G7. Exhibition partners include Havaianas and Vlisco.
watch: Fondation Engie is named in the footer as annual supporter and in the Sustainable Palais programme. Engie sells gas.
why_flagged: French state, plus patrons: Fondation Engie, Richard Mille, Ruinart, Swiss Life, Matmut, Revolut, Hugo Boss, G7. Exhibition partners include Havaianas and Vlisco.
records_note: It posts activity reports for 2020 to 2025 off its main menu, naming its board and 2025 supporters, with budget totals but no full accounts.

name: Palazzo Grassi and Punta della Dogana
funding: Private. Pinault bought Palazzo Grassi in 2005 (EUR 29M). The City of Venice owns Punta della Dogana; he holds it on a 33-year agreement and paid its EUR 20M restoration.
watch: Bottega Veneta, a Kering house, solely backs the 2026 Lorna Simpson show. Kering paid EUR 1.25bn in 2019 to settle an Italian tax case.
why_flagged: Bottega Veneta, a Kering house, solely backs the 2026 Lorna Simpson show. Kering paid EUR 1.25bn in 2019 to settle an Italian tax case.
records_note: The site lists staff led by François Pinault and the managing director; it posts no annual reports, accounts, funder list or board.

name: Peggy Guggenheim Collection
watch: Parent foundation removed the Sackler name under pressure in 2022.
why_flagged: Parent foundation removed the Sackler name under pressure in 2022.
